findings.finding: Graph admission has no explicit RNG save/restore and repeats the original callable: reference + side-stream warmup + CUDA capture + one immediate native graph replay. Only later steady replays increment the replays counter.
findings.scope: Exact LayerGraph source; zero reported replays does not imply graph was never executed.

findings.finding: For this admitted dense Nano decoder, the inspected native layer route contains no random sampling or dropout call. Numeric attention explicitly uses dropout_p=0. Global RNG preservation remains a generic wrapper concern, not a demonstrated cause here.
findings.scope: Native decoder/no memory/no prompt upsampling route; not a claim about every possible future custom module.

findings.finding: Native image transform, prompt preparation, service NumPy seed draw, vision encoding and explicit-seed diffusion noise happen before decoder graph admission. Noise uses a new local NumPy RandomState(seed); each public request resets global torch/NumPy/Python seeds, and each reset recreates the native per-episode seed stream.
findings.scope: Pinned native service/model and public harness; all25 observed actual native seeds are1826701615.

findings.finding: Conditioning-cache graphs are created independently of IFL_COSMOS3_LAYER_GRAPHS. Disabling that outer install flag alone is not a valid isolation experiment.

In the enabled generation-region route, these layer graphs service extraction admission; after state.checked the compiled pure region bypasses the original layer. Captured output is byte-checked against its same-call reference, but this does not prove whole-model resource-invariant behavior.
findings.scope: No E2E graph-on versus graph-bypass comparison has been run.

findings.finding: Actual counts agree with25 added captures: +450 module hits =25*9*2 extra Python forwards; +50 eligible and +50 fallback attention Python calls =25*2 each. Captured kernels replay without additional Python counters.
findings.scope: Historical and current backend receipts; not a causal numeric-quality conclusion.

prospective_minimum_isolation: One new explicit diagnostic that holds checkpoint, inputs, complete UniPC4/CFG3 schedule, compiler options and source fixed, compares current conditioning graph admission to disabled admission. Do not rely on the outer layer-graph flag.

Record actual pre/post decoder CPU/CUDA/NumPy RNG state hashes and preprocessed/noise input digests, plus first differing layer/gen-region inputs/outputs and compiled specialization metadata; retain both paths even if not equal.
If graph admission is not causal, compare exact Torch/Triton/cuDNN build provenance and compiler artifacts. Do not relabel the unresolved numerical difference as successful historical reproduction.
